info.name: Yjeek Admin Panel
info.description:
Yjeek Ops Admin Console — full FE screen-pack collection.

## Import
1. Import this collection
2. Import `Yjeek_Admin_Panel.postman_environment.json`
3. Select environment **Yjeek Admin Panel (Local)**

## Suggested flow
1. Auth → Login (saves accessToken or tempToken)
2. Auth → 2FA Verify if required
3. Dashboard → Overview → Live orders (copy `orderId`)
4. Vendors / Fleet / Customers list requests save IDs when possible
5. Orders → dispatch attempts/evaluations + vendor-acceptance resolve
6. Dispatch Rules → simulate (shadow, no offers written)
7. Reports → dispatch / vendor-acceptance CSV exports

Seed: {{email}} / {{password}} (use local env; do not commit real credentials)
Environment values are filled from the live database when you regenerate this collection.

Not built (hide in UI): SSO/IdP, marketing campaigns resource, admin WebSocket.
